name: strata-v100-prefill-chunks-131k
description: Prompt chunk size at the 131k window on the resident 4x V100-32G IQ3_S server: auto (8192 measured), 4096, 8192, 16384, plus the CPU prefill share env.

estimate.basis: five launches plus 3 x 34 s prefill per variant

caveats: NEW DEFINITION, first run 2026-10-27. The engine's auto chunk on this recipe was 8192; pf8192 is therefore a variance control.
STRATA_PREFILL_CPU_SHARE is documented as off for layer splits and --batch; cpushare_auto records the engine's own refusal/skip line rather than assuming a gain.
Prefill chunk size changes wall time and memory, not answer quality.
